title.zh: 月之暗面（Kimi）筹备香港 IPO，并寻求和解旧案
title.en: Moonshot AI (Kimi) prepares Hong Kong IPO and seeks settlement in old dispute

current_state.zh: Moonshot AI（Kimi）正就一起持续近两年的仲裁纠纷与前公司 Recurrent.ai 及其投资者协商和解，金额可能超过 7 亿美元，以期为香港 IPO 申报扫清障碍。
current_state.en: Moonshot AI (Kimi) is negotiating a settlement with former company Recurrent.ai and its investors over a nearly two-year arbitration dispute that could be worth over $700M, as it seeks to clear the way for its Hong Kong IPO filing.

updates.title_zh: 月之暗面（Kimi）完成IPO前最终一轮融资，估值约500亿美元
updates.title_en: 月之暗面（Kimi）完成IPO前最终一轮融资，估值约500亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: Moonshot AI（Kimi）已完成 IPO 前最后一轮私募融资，估值约 500 亿美元，并正筹备于明年第一季度在香港 IPO，与早期投资者的讨论可能于本月启动。
updates.what_changed_en: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has closed its final pre-IPO private funding round at a valuation of about $50 billion and is preparing a Hong Kong IPO targeted for the first quarter of next year, with early investor discussions potentially beginning this month.
